headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: May 18, 2026**
article:
The Tampa Bay Rays secured a 6-3 victory over the Miami Marlins, with Drew Rasmussen earning the win. Junior Caminero led the Marlins' offense with a home run and 2 RBIs. The Baltimore Orioles took down the Washington Nationals 7-3, with Gunnar Henderson leading the charge at the plate. Henderson's impressive performance included four hits, one home run, and two RBIs. The Philadelphia Phillies dominated the Pittsburgh Pirates, securing a 6-0 victory behind Zack Wheeler's strong performance on the mound.

Several key players have been impacted by injuries and availability. Cole Sulser has been placed on the 15-day injured list by the Tampa Bay Rays due to a low back strain. Kris Bubic has been placed on the 15-day injured list by the Kansas City Royals due to left elbow soreness. A.J. Minter has been placed on the 60-day injured list by the New York Mets due to left lat surgery. Other notable injuries include Brendan Donovan's left groin muscle strain and Jack Dreyer's left shoulder discomfort.

The MLB has seen several trades and roster movements. Eric Lauer has been traded from the Toronto Blue Jays to the Los Angeles Dodgers for cash. The Chicago White Sox acquired Junior Perez from the Athletics in exchange for left-hander Jackson Nove. The Athletics also traded Kyle Robinson to the Pittsburgh Pirates for second baseman Alika Williams. Additionally, Eduarniel Núñez was traded from the Athletics to the Baltimore Orioles for cash.

top_news.title: **Braves Rout Red Sox 8-1**
top_news.summary: The Atlanta Braves dominated the Boston Red Sox, winning 8-1 behind a strong performance from Grant Holmes, who pitched 6.0 innings with 4 strikeouts and 0 earned runs. Austin Riley led the Braves' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Rays Place Cole Sulser on 15-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Tampa Bay Rays right-handed pitcher Cole Sulser has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a low back strain, effective retroactive to May 15, 2026.

top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays traded left-handed pitcher Eric Lauer to the Los Angeles Dodgers for cash on May 17, 2026.
